newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-GPG moves to full Ballarat bid.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-GPG moves to full Ballarat bid.

text.p: Guinness Peat Group Plc said on Monday it plans to convert its A$2.45 a share partial takeover offer for Ballarat Brewing Co Ltd into a full bid.
The orginal offer was for half of each Ballarat shareholders' stake.
Ballarat, a tourism and leisure group, has previously recommended that its shareholders take no action in relation to GPG's offer.
The bid, which values Ballarat at A$66.4 million, is due to close on October 8.
Ballarat shares last traded at A$2.50 on Friday, when they fell five cents on the day.
